001package services;
002
003import base.User;
004import enums.Role;
005
006/** CRUD operations for {@link base.User} instances backed by {@link Database}. */
007public class UserService {
008    private static UserService instance;
009    private final Database db = Database.getInstance();
010
011    private UserService() {}
012
013    public static UserService getInstance() {
014        if (instance == null) instance = new UserService();
015        return instance;
016    }
017
018    public void addUser(User u) {
019        if (u == null) return;
020        if (db.findUserByLogin(u.getLogin()) != null) return;
021        db.addUser(u);
022        db.save();
023    }
024
025    public void removeUser(User u) {
026        if (u == null) return;
027        db.removeUser(u.getId());
028        db.save();
029    }
030
031    public void updateUser(User u) {
032        if (u == null) return;
033        User existing = db.findUserById(u.getId());
034        if (existing == null) return;
035
036        // Replace by id to avoid duplicates; keep same reference semantics simple.
037        for (int i = 0; i < db.users.size(); i++) {
038            if (db.users.get(i).getId().equals(u.getId())) {
039                db.users.set(i, u);
040                db.save();
041                return;
042            }
043        }
044    }
045
046    public User createUser(Role role, String login, String password, String name) {
047        return UserFactory.createUser(role, login, password, name);
048    }
049}
050
